record.dic_text:
07851 Shittiym {shit-teem'}

與 07848 的複數相同; 專有名詞 地名

AV - Shittim 5; 5

什亭 = "洋槐"
1) 在征服外約但河地區與過約但河進入迦南地之間以色列人紮營之處
2) 耶路撒冷西邊的一個地方
record.edic_text:
07851 Shittiym {shit-teem'}

the same as the pl. of 07848;; n pr loc

AV - Shittim 5; 5

Shittim = "the acacias"
1) place of Israel's encampment  between the conquest of the
   transjordanic region and crossing the Jordan into Canaan
2) a place west of Jerusalem
